headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.91
summary: Adds a thread freeze sampler for App-Level Logging sessions: when an in-game thread stops progressing, its name and wait channel are logged into the capture.

items.text: While App-Level Logging is enabled, a sampler watches every thread of the game process once per second and logs the thread name plus its kernel wait channel whenever a previously-active thread stalls, so in-game freezes identify the exact blocked thread.
